trajectory.name: Core

guided.text: We continue to expect to exit Q4 at the mid-single digit core revenue growth rate as we move past some of the headwinds from the first three quarters of the year.

trajectory.note: guided figure read from the sentence, not yet in the ledger

tone.method: lexical cue counts on management sentences; indicative of wording, not a measure of business health

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: We delivered a solid second quarter with better-than-expected revenue, earnings, and cash flow.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: We were particularly pleased to see an acceleration in core growth versus the first quarter, driven by good commercial execution, recent innovation, and recovery in our end market.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: While customer project timing impacted bioprocessing revenue, underlying order trends remained robust.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Improved growth across our portfolio, paired with benefits from our recent productivity initiatives, helped drive high single-digit earnings growth.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: The quarter illustrates the benefit of our balanced end market and geographic diversification while reinforcing our outlook for accelerating revenue and earnings growth in the second half and beyond.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Demand from large pharma and biopharma customers remained healthy, while improved biotech funding supported improved funnel and order activity.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: As we look to the second half of 2026 and beyond, we're encouraged by the momentum across our businesses and the long-term value creation opportunities ahead for us.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: We're well-positioned in attractive end markets with strong secular growth drivers.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Our capital deployment flywheel is active, supported by significant balance sheet optionality.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: The Danaher Business System and our team are powerful differentiators, helping us drive both growth and productivity.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Core revenue was up 3% year-over-year.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Core growth, excluding respiratory testing revenue, which highlights improvements in the underlying business trends that I mentioned a moment ago, was up 4.5%, 150 basis point acceleration from the first quarter.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: We were encouraged to see growth accelerate with improving trends across our end markets and recent innovations further driving growth across our businesses.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: In biotechnology, Cytiva launched the Biacore 8S SPR system, a high-throughput screening and characterization platform that helps researchers evaluate how potential drug candidates interact with their targets.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: In life sciences, SCIEX reinforced its leadership position in mass spectrometry with the introduction of the novus V55 at June's American Society for Mass Spectrometry Meeting.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: In diagnostics, Beckman Coulter introduced the Access BD-pTau217 Research Use Only assay and received the CE mark approval for the Access p-tau217 assay, two blood-based Alzheimer's biomarker tests for use on the DxI 9000.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Those assays further strengthen Beckman's positioning as a leader in the important and growing area of neurodegenerative diagnostics.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Now, these are just a few of many examples across Danaher and how we're positioning our businesses for continued growth and delivering on our commitment to help customers solve some of the most important challenges impacting patients around the world.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Geographically, core revenues in developed markets declined slightly as both North America and Western Europe were impacted by shipment timing in biotechnology and lower respiratory revenue year-over-year.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Core revenues in high-growth markets increased more than 10%, with healthy growth across our major regions, including mid-single-digit growth in China.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: In China, biotechnology delivered another quarter of solid growth as local companies continued to partner with Cytiva on the development of novel molecules and the manufacturing of commercial therapies.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Life sciences market conditions continued to stabilize while diagnostics improved sequentially as we began to move beyond the most significant year-over-year impacts of volume-based procurement and reimbursement changes that began in late 2024.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Our adjusted operating profit margin of 27.1% was down 20 basis points as lower respiratory revenue year-over-year more than offset the favorable impacts of higher non-respiratory volume and disciplined cost management.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Adjusted diluted net earnings per common share of $1.94 were up approximately 8% year-over-year.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: We generated $1.3 billion of free cash flow in the quarter and $2.4 billion in the first half of the year, resulting in a year-to-date free cash flow to net income conversion ratio of 124%, further underwriting the differentiated quality of our earnings.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: We also made significant progress on our capital deployment priorities during the quarter and into July.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: On the M&A front, we closed our acquisition of Masimo in early June, ahead of our initial expectations.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: We expect Masimo to be immediately accretive, both strategically and to adjusted EPS.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: The business delivered high single-digit revenue growth in the first half of the year and is off to a great start as part of Danaher, including an FDA 510(k) clearance for an AI-enabled opioid-induced respiratory depression detection solution.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: In fact, the team has already completed their first operating review, where they further validated opportunities to drive productivity and efficiency improvement, capture customer account synergies, and strengthen the innovation process using the Danaher Business System Launch Excellence tool.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Additionally, Leica Biosystems announced the pending acquisition of StatLab, a leading manufacturer of consumables across the anatomical pathology workflow.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: StatLab has built a strong reputation with customers for its quality, innovation, and customer intimacy.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: We believe the acquisition will strengthen Leica Biosystems' value proposition by bringing together consumables, instruments, automation, and digital pathology into a more complete workflow solution.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: It also supports our broader integrated delivery network strategy and our goal of helping clinicians diagnose cancer faster and more precisely.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: StatLab generated approximately $250 million in revenue for the full year of 2025 and has an attractive business model with more than 85% recurring revenue.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: We expect the business to grow high single digits over the long term and to be accretive to adjusted EPS in our first full year of ownership.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: While the transaction remains subject to customary closing conditions, including regulatory approvals, we expect to close by the end of 2026.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Lastly, we deployed approximately $900 million of capital to repurchase 5 million shares of Danaher common stock.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: We believe these repurchases will provide an attractive return given the trajectory of our long-term organic growth, earnings, and cash flow outlook.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Core revenue in our biotechnology segment increased 2.5%.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Core revenue in discovery and medical increased mid-single digits, with solid growth in pharma and biopharma, and a more stable academic and research funding environment.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Core revenue in bioprocessing grew low single digits in the second quarter, with low single-digit growth in both consumables and equipment.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: We were encouraged to see equipment growth in the second quarter following several quarters of improving order trends, supported by customer investments in manufacturing capacity.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: While revenue was impacted by customer timing, underlying demand remained very healthy, with mid-teens order growth in both consumables and equipment.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: The trends we're seeing in the business, together with healthy underlying demand, reinforce our confidence in the high single-digit long-term outlook for Cytiva's bioprocessing franchise.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Cytiva is well-positioned to support capacity expansions as we expect onshoring activity to accelerate and commercial production to remain robust, particularly in monoclonal antibodies.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: At the same time, new molecules continue to progress through development pipelines and into commercialization, creating what we believe is a durable long-term growth opportunity given Cytiva's leading and expanding specced-in position on molecules in pre-clinical and early-stage clinical development phases.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Turning to our Life Sciences segment, core revenue increased 5.5%.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Core revenue in Pall's applied filtration business increased approximately 10%, led by strength in its microelectronics product line.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Core revenue in our Life Sciences instrument businesses increased mid-single digits in the quarter.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Across our end markets, investment from large pharma and biopharma customers continued to strengthen, while biotech demand benefited from a more favorable funding environment.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Academic demand improved modestly as the quarter progressed but remained below normal levels.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: By operating company, we saw solid growth at Beckman Life Sciences, Leica Microsystems, and SCIEX.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Beckman Life Sciences saw notable growth in automation, where the team is well-positioned to benefit as customers invest in the lab infrastructure needed to support autonomous labs and AI-enabled drug discovery.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Core revenue in our Life Sciences consumables businesses collectively grew low single digits.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: IDT was up in the quarter, led by demand for MRD testing solutions, and Abcam's growth continued to accelerate, delivering its best quarter since acquisition as academic markets have started to improve and commercial initiatives, particularly around biopharma and diagnostic end markets, gained further traction.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: As end market conditions continue to improve, we expect commercial and go-to-market execution, including autonomous lab-catalyzed demand, to further support growth acceleration across Abcam, IDT, and Aldevron.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Moving to our Diagnostics segment, core revenue increased 2%.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Core growth, excluding respiratory testing revenue, was up 5%.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Core revenue in our clinical diagnostics businesses was up mid-single digits, with high single-digit growth outside of China.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Leica Biosystems and Radiometer were collectively up high single digits, with solid growth across both instruments and consumables.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Beckman Coulter Diagnostics was up mid-single digits globally, with another quarter of solid immunoassay revenue and install base growth.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: At Beckman, declines in China began to moderate as pricing stabilized and volumes improved.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: In molecular diagnostics, Cepheid's core non-respiratory revenue increased low double digits, led by growth in hospital-acquired infection and sexual health assays.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: This strong performance was supported by continued adoption of recent menu expansions, including the Multiplex GI panel, as well as several notable key account wins with large hospital networks.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: We expect third quarter revenue growth to be approximately 2%-3%, which includes an approximately 250 basis point year-over-year headwind from respiratory testing.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: This implies that core growth excluding respiratory will be approximately 5%, an acceleration versus what we saw in the second quarter.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: We continue to expect to exit Q4 at the mid-single digit core revenue growth rate as we move past some of the headwinds from the first three quarters of the year.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: This results in a full year 2026 core revenue growth outlook in the range of 3%-4%.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Our updated outlook reflects higher anticipated core revenue growth in our life sciences segment as we expect these markets to recover faster than our initial expectations, offset by a slightly more conservative outlook for bioprocessing, given some of the customer-driven timing dynamics we saw in the second quarter.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Additionally, given our second quarter earnings beat and the earlier than anticipated completion of the Masimo acquisition, we're raising our full-year adjusted diluted net EPS guidance to a range of $8.45-$8.60, versus our previous range of $8.35-$8.55.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Finally, we expect a third quarter adjusted operating profit margin of approximately 26.5%.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: To wrap up, we're pleased to deliver better than expected second quarter results and are encouraged by the underlying momentum that is built across our portfolio.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Growth accelerated, reflecting improved end markets, strong commercial execution, and the power of our balanced portfolio.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Traction on recent product launches also drove growth and share gains across a number of our businesses.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: We remain confident that growth will accelerate toward a mid-single digit exit rate this year.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: As markets recover, we expect our growth initiatives to gain further traction.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: At the same time, we believe AI will strengthen the Danaher Business System, reinforcing our culture of continuous improvement and supporting our work to achieve margin expansion and earnings growth.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Looking ahead, our leading portfolio, significant capital deployment optionality, and talented team, all powered by the Danaher Business System, will continue to position us to help customers move from discovery to delivery faster, accelerate the impact of science and technology, and create sustainable long-term value for shareholders.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: To recap, our bioprocessing business grew low single digits this quarter, and that was both for equipment and consumables.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: These delays were at our customer's request due to production schedule changes and site readiness challenges, which we have seen occasionally.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: We think our portfolio is differentiated, and that's supported by our strong order book trends as consumables and equipment orders both grew mid-teens in the second quarter.

signals.speaker: Matt Gugino
signals.sentence: That's a couple of hundred basis points to our bioprocessing growth for the full year.

signals.speaker: Matt Gugino
signals.sentence: I think the other thing just to note here on Q2 is that outside of chromatography resins that Rainer referenced, we saw pretty good performance in the quarter in consumables, and that included strong double-digit growth in our upstream consumables business.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: In fact, we are pleased with the fact that we're starting to see revenue growth here on the equipment side.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: In fact, we do believe that this is a twofold signal that we are starting to see some of that reshoring brownfield expansion, not just playing through in the order strength that you've seen over previous quarters, but we're also starting to see some of that in the revenue line.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: The other aspect, this comes back to Mike's question a little bit, there continues to be robust demand for biologic molecules, therapeutics.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: We haven't had a lot of investment, as you know, in capacity expansions over the last several years.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: There is this need to continue to invest in capacity expansion coupled with the reshoring dynamic.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Now, as it relates to the greenfield investments, we're quoting for those.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: We continue to believe that we're in the early innings here of a multi-year CapEx cycle that is required both to support the growing volumes of biologic therapeutics, but also the reshoring dynamic.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: We're seeing that funding that we see in all the announcements starting to play through.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: On Abcam, we've had the best quarter here that we've had since the acquisition, where you see not only the work that we're doing driving growth and share capture, but we're also seeing some more stability in academic markets.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: There are delays in that regard.

signals.speaker: Matt Gugino
signals.sentence: Obviously, we have some variability here with the respiratory headwinds from quarter to quarter, but I think if you unpack it, excluding respiratory, diagnostics was solid, mid-single digits in the second quarter.

signals.speaker: Matt Gugino
signals.sentence: I think we're encouraged by some of that execution we're seeing commercially across the platform, as well as some of those new product innovations that are driving accelerated growth, like that DxI 9000 at Beckman, the continued menu expansion at Cepheid.

signals.speaker: Matt Gugino
signals.sentence: I think our view is these underlying trends continue, and as respiratory headwinds moderate in Q4, we'll exit at that overall mid-single digit rate.

signals.speaker: Matt Gugino
signals.sentence: Remember here, Dan, we do have China policy, those headwinds are starting to lessen.

signals.speaker: Matt Gugino
signals.sentence: You see a little bit lower of a headwind here in Q3 and Q4, which are driving a bit more of the overall step up as well.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: We're really excited by the fact that we were able to get that acquisition closed a little bit earlier than we thought.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: In our initial operating reviews, this is every bit the company that we thought it was.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: You might have heard there that we are already launched with a new 510 on a new assay.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: As we think about the growth rate, we validated that that was high single digits here for the quarter.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Well, it is difficult to say because what we're seeing in the academic funding area, Scott, is related to government policies.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: So, we watch that with great interest because in many ways, it's a catalyst to innovation going forward.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: We're pretty pleased with the nice growth that we have seen here at Pall, which has been ongoing for some time.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: In fact, we've invested quite significantly in the past years in this business, both in innovation as well as capacity, where we are currently in the startup mode of a new plant in Singapore, which is right in the middle of many of the demand centers there, along with our plants elsewhere in the world, including the U.S.

signals.speaker: Matt Gugino
signals.sentence: I think as Rainer talked about the drivers there, but we also probably saw some share gains here at Pall overall.

signals.speaker: Matt Gugino
signals.sentence: We think that growth moderates a bit here in Q3; in the second half, in general, those underlying trends are pretty consistent.

signals.speaker: Matt Gugino
signals.sentence: I think first off, there's no change on how we're thinking about mid-single digit core growth.

signals.speaker: Matt Gugino
signals.sentence: Thinking maybe a touch high there in what you're referencing, but mid-single digit core growth in Q4.

signals.speaker: Matt Gugino
signals.sentence: For the full year, we're thinking that 3%-4% core growth range.

signals.speaker: Matt Gugino
signals.sentence: Respiratory, we're thinking given where infection rates have trended, about $1.6 billion or a touch below that for the full year.

signals.speaker: Matt Gugino
signals.sentence: As we're talking and you're thinking about the second half, it's important to look at the underlying trends in the business as well as the impact of respiratory from quarter to quarter.

signals.speaker: Matt Gugino
signals.sentence: That's an acceleration versus what we saw in Q1.

signals.speaker: Matt Gugino
signals.sentence: Respiratory was about 150 basis point headwind in Q2.

signals.speaker: Matt Gugino
signals.sentence: We think it's about 250 basis point headwind in Q3, and those headwinds essentially go away year-on-year in Q4.

signals.speaker: Matt Gugino
signals.sentence: That's why we're feeling comfortable with that Q4 mid-single digit core growth rate.

signals.speaker: Matt Gugino
signals.sentence: Rainer talked about core growth, high single digits, even a little bit better than we expected.

signals.speaker: Matt Gugino
signals.sentence: We think that's a good place to be halfway through the year and balance a strong fall through while being able to reinvest for growth.

signals.speaker: Matt Gugino
signals.sentence: That's a couple hundred basis points impact to bioprocessing growth for the full year.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: We believe, without talking specifically to 2027, that these push outs to 2027 would likely then ultimately ship in 2027.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: What we see is broad-based growth across our customer base of these in the mid-teens of both consumables, as well as equipment.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: It is rare that you get a consumable order, especially on these larger sized ones, that book in the quarter and ship in the same quarter.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: The majority of the business is shipped in the quarter that comes out of backlog.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: These continue to be Radiometer and Leica Biosystems, our specialty diagnostics businesses for us that continue to grow in the high single-digit range.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Continued innovation, continued commercial excellence.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: I might add the StatLab acquisition that really strengthens Leica Biosystems offering across the entire workflow and provides leverage across that entire workflow.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: It's got great economics, and we expect that to grow high single digits here in the long term as well.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: I think it's important to note, again, on the orders, that we see broad-based orders here, growth in the mid-teens, in the consumables area and in the equipment area.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: As it relates to our other consumables, whether that's single use, whether that's upstream in the bioreactor area and so forth, our growth is very strong there in the upstream area as well.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Large pharma and biopharma customers are progressing back to normal; we continue to see that.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: Abcam delivered their strongest quarter since acquisition, and they benefited from improved commercial execution, certainly.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: We're also taking some share here and making headway in other end markets to skew away a little bit from academic.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: We also think the new products are contributing to our growth in our life science instrument businesses, flow cytometry at Beckman, the novus V55 and 8600 at SCIEX.

signals.speaker: Rainer M. Blair
signals.sentence: We expect this momentum continues in the second half, and that's what gave us confidence here to raise our full year life science guide.
